children: Ondas Inc. (NASDAQ:ONDS) reported Q2 revenue of $83.8M, raised its 2026 guide to $525–$550M while deploying ~$325M on DZYNE and Cyberhawk and holding ~$1.4B cash; it forecasts strong GATE growth but faces heavy short interest and set resale caps as Needham holds a $19 target.
: Ondas Inc. (ONDS) Q2 2026 revenue $83.8M; raised 2026 revenue guide to $525M–$550M. Cash on hand ~$1.4B as of June 30; ~$325M used for DZYNE and Cyberhawk acquisitions.
: Ondas (ONDS) forecasts GATE Technologies revenue of $65M in 2026 and $180M in 2028, with GATE delivering over $130M EBITDA through 2028. GATE supplies ESADs and electronic fuzing for weapons.
: Ondas Inc. (ONDS) had 226.57M shares sold short, equal to 39.89% of its 567.97M float — the largest raw short position among the names listed.
: Ondas Inc. (ONDS) set daily sale caps for Gate and Bron holders at 15% of 10‑day average volume and will file resale prospectus supplements to support orderly share resales.
: Needham maintained a $19.00 per share price target for Ondas Inc. (ONDS), according to Benzinga, and the report noted analyst rating actions related to Ondas Inc. (ONDS).
: Ondas Inc. (ONDS) took part in Phase 1 of the Pentagon’s Drone Dominance program but was not chosen for the Gauntlet II event; it remains eligible for future Gauntlet rounds.
